notifications.name: Deck
notifications.author: danennh11
notifications.summary: Terminal-pane card with a λ prompt and a blue app pill
notifications.description: Each notification arrives as a small terminal pane: the app name in a dark-blue pill like a prompt path, the summary after a λ, the body lined up beneath, outlined action tabs, a left rail that turns red for urgent ones and a hairline that drains while it waits. Every colour comes from the live palette.
